kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-table --table-name tableName1 --columns ColumnName=columnName1 ColumnType=string --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTable

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create a view or a table. Valid values:
0: table.
1: view
parameters.help_zh:
指定创建视图或创建表：
0为创建表。
1为创建视图
parameters.name: is_view

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the visibility of the table and the workspace. Valid values:
0: The table and the workspace are both invisible.
1: The table and the workspace are both visible.
2: Only the workspace is visible
parameters.help_zh:
表或工作空间是否可见：
0为表和工作空间均不可见。
1为表和工作空间均可见。
2为仅工作空间可见
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en: The lifecycle of the table, in days. The default value is empty, which indicates permanent storage
parameters.help_zh: 表的生命周期，单位为天。默认取值为空，表示永久存储
parameters.name: life_cycle

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated category. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173932.html operation to query the IDs of available categories
parameters.help_zh: 关联类目的ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173932.html接口查询可以关联的类目ID
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the logical level
parameters.name: logical_level_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the physical level
parameters.name: physics_level_id

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the external table. Valid values:
0: OSS.
1: Tablestore.
2: Volume.
3: MySQL
parameters.help_zh:
外部表的存储类型。取值如下：
0表示OSS。
1表示TableStore。
2表示Volume。
3表示MySQL
parameters.name: external_table_type

parameters.help_en: The storage address of the external table
parameters.name: location

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The environment of the DataWorks workspace. Valid values:
0: development environment.
1: production environment
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的环境。取值如下：
0表示开发环境。
1表示生产环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the MaxCompute project. The format is odps.{projectName}
parameters.name: app_guid

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the created MaxCompute table is a partitioned table. Valid values: 1 (yes) and 0 (no). [Deprecated] Do not use this parameter. The system determines whether the MaxCompute table is a partitioned table based on the Column.N.isPartitionCol parameter. If the Column.N.isPartitionCol parameter is set to true, the MaxCompute table is considered a partitioned table
parameters.help_zh:
创建的MaxCompute表是否为分区表，包括1（是）和0（否）。该字段已废弃，请勿使用。
目前代码会根据Column.N.isPartitionCol参数判断MaxCompute表是否为分区表，当Column.N.isPartitionCol参数取值为true时，则认为MaxCompute表为分区表
parameters.name: has_part

parameters.help_en: The schema information of the table. In MaxCompute, you must specify the schema information when the three-level model is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 表Schema信息。在ODPS，当您启动了三层模型时需要填写Schema信息
parameters.name: schema

fields.help_en: The name of the column. The CreateTable operation supports a maximum of 1,000 columns
fields.help_zh:
字段的名称。
CreateTable API当前最多支持配置1000个字段
fields.name: column_name

fields.help_en: The Chinese name of the column
fields.name: column_name_cn

fields.help_en: The data type of the column. The supported data types depend on the data type edition used by your MaxCompute project. For more information about the data types supported by each edition, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27821.html
fields.help_zh: 字段的类型。此处支持的字段类型，取决于您MaxCompute项目使用的数据类型版本，各版本支持的数据类型请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27821.html
fields.name: column_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the current column is a partition column
fields.help_zh: 当前字段是否为分区字段
fields.name: is_partition_col

fields.help_en: The length of the column. For more information, see <props="intl">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159541.html</props><props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159541.html</props>
fields.name: length

fields.help_en: The sequence number of the column. You can specify the order of columns in the table. By default, columns are sorted in the order they are specified in the creation request. If the column is a partition column, you cannot configure Columns.N.SeqNumber
fields.help_zh:
字段的序列号。您可以指定字段在表中的排序，默认按照创建请求的顺序排序。
如果字段为分区字段，则不支持配置Columns.N.SeqNumber
fields.name: seq_number

parameters.help_en: The list of columns. A maximum of 1,000 columns are supported
parameters.help_zh: 字段列表，最大支持1000个字段
parameters.name: columns

fields.help_en: The theme level corresponding to the theme ID
fields.name: theme_level

TaskInfo.description_en:
The information about the request task. After a request task is submitted, it is divided into multiple subtasks that are executed in sequence. The next subtask is executed only after the current subtask is executed. The request task ends when all subtasks are completed.

The request task is terminated in the following scenarios. You must troubleshoot the issue based on the error code and resubmit the request task:
The request task fails to be submitted.
A subtask fails to be executed after the request task is submitted
TaskInfo.description_zh:
请求任务的信息。
请求任务提交成功后，会被分为多个子任务有序执行。当前子任务执行成功后，才会继续执行下一个子任务，所有子任务执行完毕，该请求任务结束。

如下情况，请求任务会终止，您需要根据错误码信息解决问题后重新发起请求任务：
请求任务提交失败。
请求任务提交成功后，任意子任务执行失败

Content.description_en:
The detailed execution status of the current subtask. Details:
If the execution is successful, success is displayed.
If the execution fails, the corresponding error details are displayed
Content.description_zh:
当前子任务的执行状态详细信息。具体如下：
执行成功，则显示success。
执行失败则显示对应的报错详情

NextTaskId.description_en: The ID of the next subtask to be executed. If this parameter is empty, all subtasks are completed
NextTaskId.description_zh: 即将执行的子任务ID。如果该字段为空，则表示所有子任务均已结束

Status.description_en:
The status of the current subtask. Valid values:
operating: The subtask is being executed.
success: The subtask is executed successfully.
failure: The subtask fails to be executed. For more information about the error details, see the Content parameter
Status.description_zh:
当前执行的子任务的状态信息。取值如下：
operating表示子任务正在执行中。
success表示子任务执行成功。
failure表示子任务执行失败。详细的报错信息请参见Content参数

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the current subtask
